stubs.service: Litekart commerce API (https://api.litekart.in) — store record, menus, catalog, Meilisearch search/autocomplete, cart, checkout, auth, addresses, orders, wishlist, reviews, coupons, blog/CMS pages, FAQs
stubs.how: Local Node HTTP server .ui-capture/stub/server.mjs on 127.0.0.1:4422 serving .ui-capture/stub/db.json (generated by seed.mjs). The app is pointed at it with PUBLIC_LITEKART_API_URL, so SSR calls go there via handleFetch and browser /api/* calls go through the app's own production /api proxy. Carts, wishlist toggles and sessions are kept in memory.

stubs.service: Product / category / editorial photography (originally the merchant's CDN and images.unsplash.com in the default theme)
stubs.how: Unsplash sample photos bundled in the @vendure/create npm package, copied to .ui-capture/stub/images and served by the stub at /api/media/<file>; homepage hero/tiles/banner images are set through the store record's theme.content (the Litekart admin override path).

stubs.service: Google Fonts (Inter for the default theme)
stubs.how: Inter woff2 files from the @fontsource/inter npm package, served by the stub at /api/fonts/css2 + /api/fonts/files/*; the default theme's font URL in src/lib/theme/index.ts points there.

stubs.service: Payment providers (Stripe, PayPal, COD via Litekart /api/checkout/*)
stubs.how: Stub endpoints return a placed order number (NF-25201) without contacting any provider.
Stub /api/auth/login checks the seeded account and sets the connect.sid + me cookies the storefront reads; signup/OTP/forgot-password endpoints answer success locally.

stubs.service: Litekart Conversational Shopping assistant (/api/commerce-assistant/*: config, sessions, messages, add-to-cart, events)
stubs.how: Implemented in the stub. /config answers 200 with enabled:false because this store keeps the advisor off (the storefront widget's built-in prompts are jewellery-specific), so the widget stays hidden. Run start.sh with STUB_ASSISTANT=on to enable it; messages are then answered from the catalogue (category + budget parsing, ranked recommendations with prices, ratings, stock and delivery estimates).

stubs.service: Newsletter signup, contact/enquiry forms, uploads, shipping zones
stubs.how: Stub endpoints return success / realistic data locally.

notes: SvelteKit 2 storefront (Svelte 5) on its stock Litekart connector, run as the production adapter-node build (build/) by .ui-capture/start.sh, which also starts the API stub. Tooling pinned in mise.toml (node 24.22.3, bun 1.4.4); deps via `bun install --frozen-lockfile`, build via `bun run build`. Changes to the repo, all only to make it build/run offline: src/hooks.server.ts reads the optional connector hook setRequestHost via Reflect.get (the production build otherwise turns it into a named import Litekart 2.0.29 does not export and crashes at boot); src/lib/theme/index.ts serves Inter locally; start.sh preloads .ui-capture/node-require-shim.mjs because adapter-node bundles jsdom (used by kitcommerce-core's HTML sanitizer) and its require.resolve breaks under ESM. Data (seed.mjs -> db.json): store 'Northfield Supply Co.' (Oakland, CA, USD) with menus, plugins (wishlist, reviews, coupons, search) and homepage copy; 54 products / 9 categories from Vendure's sample catalog with variants (sizes, RAM/screen, colours), sale prices, sold-out and low-stock items; ~200 reviews; customer Megan Okafor (signed-in account above) with 26 orders over ~16 months (Delivered, Shipped, Processing, Pending, Cancelled, Returned; coupons, COD/PayPal/card), 4 saved addresses, 10 wishlist items, 2 items in her saved bag, 5 of her own reviews; 9 journal posts, 5 policy/about pages, 6 FAQs, 5 coupons. Main areas: home (/), catalogue (/products, category pages like /furniture, /plants, /camera-and-photo), product pages (/products/<slug>), search, cart (/cart, /checkout/*), account (/my, /my/orders, /my/orders/<orderNo e.g. NF-24117>, /my/wishlist, /my/addresses, /my/profile, /my/buy-again), journal (/blog), /faqs, /about-us and policy pages. Sign in from the header account icon with the login above to see the established customer's account, bag and wishlist.
